predeclaredScope.sequence: ascending then descending, two observations per size
predeclaredScope.variable: Generated ordinary C# methods in each task assigned source file; real Unity compilation, domain reload and selected-asset validation.
predeclaredScope.decision: Report per-size observations and duplicate range; compare fixed added work time vs proportional model residuals. One small sequence cannot establish general scaling; if isolated duration span is small or residuals exceed repeat variation, report inconclusive/mixed. Never derive a universal multiplier from one size.
predeclaredScope.stop: Preserve exact task/request on failure or uncertain completion; do not repeat writes automatically. Finish normal owned preservation/reclamation and original restoration after successful sequence.

actualLibraryInputDeviation.scope: The predeclared strict whole-Library equality assertion failed after successful restore. Only the stale PID marker for the user-approved terminated server is absent. Source and all remaining compilation-cache bytes match; do not describe the two methods as having byte-identical complete Libraries.

models.definition: E = shared pair mean / 2; S = parallel pair mean, both include compilation and the same selected asset checks. Unweighted fits on four level means; no independent-sample significance or extrapolation claim.
models.confounding: This is a continued-workspace sequence, not a fresh baseline before every refresh. Shared B follows the current A workload; independent B follows its own previous workload. Thus E is a balanced descriptive equivalent, not an experimentally matched isolated service time for both parallel workers. Prior source/assembly state and cumulative Library/journal state are not separately controlled; fitted coefficients cannot establish causal fixed or proportional overhead.

failedPreparationExcluded.cause: Existing MCP server held Library log open for writing, conflicting with immutable capture.

totals.boundary: Sum of observed operation intervals, including resumed setup. Excludes read-only proofs, generated-input preparation, AI/tool waiting, and the separately recorded failed preparation/server recovery. Lifecycle is one sequence of eight trials, not charged eight times.
